About BOW.

Experienced people.
Enduring partnerships.

BOW Projects Australia provides construction services across commercial, residential and industrial projects, with an expanding focus on public infrastructure and energy.

Our group brings together BOW Projects Victoria, BOW Projects Queensland and the dedicated BOW Structures division. The people behind BOW bring experience across major sporting venues, high-rise and mixed-use developments, hospitals and transport infrastructure.

By connecting construction leadership with structural engineering and commercial understanding, we take a practical, collaborative approach to building places that serve their people.
